verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs describe only a single API key mechanism that by default grants full 'Owner permissions' (acting like any other user) rather than any scoped or least-privilege role for agents; there is no evidence of granular API key scopes, restricted roles, or agent-specific credential issuance. missing for 10: any documentation of scoped/role-restricted API keys, per-agent credential scoping, or least-privilege token issuance.
